name: Quiz Me
description: Tell it what you're studying, or paste your notes, and your AI makes a multiple-choice quiz with an explanation for every answer.
prompt: A quiz generator: type a topic or paste your notes, choose the level and number of questions, and the AI creates a multiple-choice quiz. After each answer show whether it was right and why, and at the end a score ring and a list of past quizzes.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Dile qué estás estudiando o pega tus apuntes y tu IA te hace un test con explicación en cada respuesta.
